item.title: Nintendo sues the US government over Trump-era tariffs
item.description: Nintendo is taking a hard line against the US government and is now reported to have filed a lawsuit against it in an attempt to recover all the money paid in customs duties during Donald Trump's trade war. The background to this is that the US Supreme Court recently ruled that the extensive import tariffs introduced under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act were in fact illegal.
